actions.summary: Elementary students may not use generative AI; secondary use continues under 'guard rails'; personal devices barred during instruction and no district tablets/laptops for preschool and kindergarten. The superintendent must inventory all generative-AI tools by 2027-01-14 and pilot a whitelist-only firewall at six schools.
actions.notes: Board language: students 'should not be an ungoverned test case'. effective_from is the approximate first day of 2026-27; the board said 'going forward'. Enrollment figure is approximate.
